musaf_repetition_vattitten_lanu.he: The joined primary fragments (readings.json:57813-57906) match the blind reading except at לָֽנוּ and מִצְרָֽיִם. There the blind reading has no meteg and the primary has one. Human 379a/b settles both in favour of the primary. The bracketed Shabbat fragments match: same text, same span, and the bracket opens at the end of line 1 and closes at the start of line 2. The maqafs in וַתִּתֶּן־לָֽנוּ and אֶת־יוֹם are in both.
musaf_repetition_vattitten_lanu.en: Identical once the incipit is set aside and convoca-tion is joined, including the three bracketed fragments.

blind_doubts_settled.וְאֶת יוֹם) / (זִכְרוֹן): Pointed as in the candidate, per final-source-252 (s252-line14).
blind_doubts_settled.אַתָּה, הַלְּשׁוֹנוֹת, וְקִדַּשְׁתָּנוּ,: These are only doubts about resolution. The blind reader's own text already has these marks, so there is no difference from the primary.
blind_doubts_settled.קֹדֶשׁ possible meteg: In s252-line15 the tick below the qof matches the qof's own tail as seen in הַקָּדוֹשׁ and קָרָאתָ (s252-line12). Not a meteg, so no difference.

remaining_disputes.words: בְחַרְתָּנוּ, אוֹתָנוּ, בָּנוּ (s252-line10); וְקֵרַבְתָּנוּ and possibly וְרוֹמַמְתָּנוּ / וְקִדַּשְׁתָּנוּ (s252-line11)
remaining_disputes.issue: Under the qamats of the stressed second-to-last syllable there seems to be a second vertical stroke. It has the same 'qamats + stroke' shape as the human-confirmed meteg in לָֽנוּ (s252-line13). It is not a lamed rising from the line below: the next line has no lamed at those positions (checked on s252.jpg). Neither the blind reader nor the primary encodes it, and the blind reader placed its meteg doubts on other letters (ח, ק). No enlarged-image resolution or human ruling covers it. At this crop resolution I can't tell a meteg from a print artefact, so I am not proposing to add it from expectation alone.
remaining_disputes.needed: An enlarged crop or a human ruling: is there a meteg next to the qamats of תָּ in בְחַרְתָּנוּ, תָ in אוֹתָנוּ, בָּ in בָּנוּ and תָּ in וְקֵרַבְתָּנוּ?
